decision: Add bounded draining, checkpoint sequence checks, and exclusive workspace transfer

decision: Authorize the exact integrated candidate and expected destination revision

decision: Keep old worker budget reserved until charges can no longer accrue
why: Lease expiry does not prove infrastructure termination

decision: Show a concrete return screen, keep review independent of compute, and limit automatic unfinished work
